liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): The transition from Estimated Prophet to Eyes Of The World is considered unbeatable; The run from Estimated Prophet to Eyes Of The World was a standout [4][12]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Stagger Lee was identified as a standout performance during the show [12]
- **Victim Or The Crime** (1 review): Victim Or The Crime is highlighted as being exceptionally sweet and well-performed [4]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Good Lovin' was a weak performance by the band, not a recording issue [4]

## The recordings

- **gd94-09-16.akg.seff.2642.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 161 min; rated 3.44/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording quality is described as excellent and highly recommended for its audio fidelity; The audience recording is noted for having very high audio quality [4][7]
- **gd1994-09-16.141688.OTS.s2.Neumann.Silberman.Ammons.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 11 songs; 108 min [3]. Said about its sound: The right channel faded out in Space, compensated with a left channel patch [3]
- **gd1994-09-16.136859.set2.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 11 songs; 109 min [2]

## Around the show

- The listener had a religious experience after taking shrooms in the parking lot [8]
- The listener came out of the experience right before the Liberty encore [8]
- The listener flew from Spokane to attend their first Bay Area shows [9]
- The listener found a ticket for the first show of the run easily [9]
- Bob Weir played acoustic guitar during the Black Throated Wind performance [2]
- Bob Weir played acoustic guitar during the Black Throated Wind performance [3]
- This show was rated the best of the 1994 run, surpassing other Dead shows [6]
- The performance was superior to Phish shows attended in 1994 at Santa Fe and Laguna Seca [6]
- The first set had better energy than the second set overall [10]
- Energy began to lag after If The Shoe Fits in the second set [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-09-16.akg.seff.2642.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: Audience: AKG C61 Tubes [1]. Also: Transfer chain includes DA-20mkII, Hosa S/PDIF, Delta DiO 2496, and Peak software [1]
- **gd1994-09-16.141688.OTS.s2.Neumann.Silberman.Ammons.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Jeff Silberman; transferred by Joe Noel and John Ammons; source: flac16/48kHz ; Set 2 Jeff Silberman Digital Recording; Neumann U89 > StellaDAT > DAT (mics spaced 40', front row, OTS); John Ammons Transfer; DAT clone >… [3]
- **gd1994-09-16.136859.set2.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - September 16, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/september-16-1994) [14]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - September 17, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/september-17-1994) [15]
